Callout.Name: Cyber Fraud - Server Address
Callout.Message: Server address linked to a fraud network.
Callout.Advisory: Unit in a business park, nobody outside.

Script.Line: It is a server room. It does what servers do.
I rent the unit, I pay the rent, I keep it locked.
You want a name? I do not have a name. The money comes by transfer.

Lines.Approach: The address is a unit in a business park and it has been paid for a year in advance.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
